score_reasons.quality: Masterful watercolor execution: soft ink washes, genuine paper grain, splattered blossom-fall edges and fly-white brush breaks as requested. The main profile is anatomically elegant (closed eye with fine lashes, correct nose/lip line), inner vignettes (pavilion, arched garden bridge, ladies at a writing table, moon gate, candle, open book) are painted consistently at their small scales without anatomical breaks. Only the pseudo-calligraphy on the book pages and stylized seal marks are invented squiggles, which is acceptable in-world but not true text.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Near-perfect poster composition: restrained sepia-grey-blush palette with red accents, generous negative space on the left column, vertical calligraphic title, and a quiet, nostalgic, sacred-poetic mood exactly matching the brief. The silhouette-to-scene transitions use misty aerial perspective seamlessly — no collage feel.
score_reasons.alignment: Every requirement is met: a large elegant profile silhouette filled with a thematically bound worldview (garden architecture, character groupings, symbolic blossoms, props like book/candle/seal), double-exposure-style fusion in a cinematic-poster-plus-watercolor register, mist transitions, paper grain, edge brushwork, large whitespace, restrained high-end layout. The theme (Dream of the Red Chamber) is instantly identifiable via title, opening poem and scenes. The专属签名 'WHY' is placed bottom-left, small, refined, with a matching mini seal — integrated like an author's chop, not disruptive.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Cultural elements withstand scrutiny: title 红楼梦 is correct; the visible poem lines 满纸荒唐言 / 一把辛酸泪 / 都云作者痴 verbatim match the famous opening of the novel; Qing-style costumes, garden pavilion, moon gate and seal stamps fit the work's aesthetic. Deductions: the poem appears truncated (the fourth line 谁解其中味 is not visible), seal and book-page characters are pseudo-script.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Outstanding realization of a demanding synthesis brief: multiple narrative vignettes grow organically inside the contour, information hierarchy (title → poem → scenes → signature) is flawless, and the design reads as a collectible edition poster rather than a template collage.
